open_points.subject: StandingGrant revoke scope across flow version changes (M25 vs State 0 action)
open_points.text: State 0 action: "grant or revoke a standing approval for a node of a flow's active version"; M25 lifecycle: "when another version becomes active, the grant keeps covering the runs pinned to its version".
open_points.question: After a new flow version becomes active, can the owner revoke an active grant on the previously active version (which still affects in-flight runs pinned to that old version), or are revoke actions limited to the currently active version only?
options: Revoke is allowed only for nodes of the currently active flow version.
Revoke is allowed for any flow version that still has an active grant.
All grants are auto-revoked when a different flow version is activated.
open_points.default_guess: Revoke is allowed for any flow version that still has an active grant.

open_points.subject: Rollback admission requirement (M08/M09 and rollback action)
open_points.text: State 0 rollback failure: "an implementation not admitted over the current corpus is refused"; M08 source: "Computed by the kernel when an implementation is submitted"; M09 rollback source: "choosing an earlier implementation admitted over the current corpus".
open_points.question: If an earlier implementation has no admission verdict over the current corpus, does rollback trigger a fresh admission run, or must such a verdict already exist before rollback is attempted?
options: Rollback triggers a new admission evaluation of the chosen implementation against the current corpus.
Rollback is refused unless an admitted verdict over the current corpus already exists.
Caller must resubmit the same implementation first (to produce a current-corpus verdict), then rollback.
open_points.default_guess: Rollback triggers a new admission evaluation against the current corpus.

open_points.subject: Effectful flow activation request path (M18 and State 0 activate action)
open_points.text: State 0: "activate a flow | agent asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once, the owner activates any other"; M18 defines only FlowActivation.
open_points.question: When an agent asks to activate a proven non-read-only flow, is there a persisted activation request for later owner decision, or is the agent call simply refused/blocked until the owner performs activation directly?
options: Create and persist an activation-request record for owner action.
Do not persist a request; return an owner-required refusal and require owner to call activate.
Allow agent call to synchronously forward/impersonate owner decision path (with owner token).
open_points.default_guess: Do not persist a request; return owner-required refusal and require owner to activate directly.

open_points.subject: FlowConstant carriage for file inputs (M16 vs M21/K-10)
open_points.text: M16: "A typed literal pinned in a flow version and delivered to one input port like any other value" with `value`: StoredValue; M21: "`carriage`: `value`, or `file` only for a trial case's file fixture (K-10)".
open_points.question: Can a flow constant ever be a file (and target a file input port), or are flow constants restricted to value carriage only?
options: Flow constants are value-only; proof refuses constants targeting file ports.
Flow constants may include files, stored as durable fixtures similar to trial files.
Flow constants may include file references (not bytes) that are resolved at run time.
open_points.default_guess: Flow constants are value-only; constants to file ports are refused.

open_points.subject: Agent readability of EffectApproval records (M24 vs primary inspect/read actions)
open_points.text: Primary actions list inspect targets as "functions, flows, runs, bindings" and separate "read a trace"; M24 says: "agents may read approvals".
open_points.question: Through which product action are EffectApproval records readable to agents (inspect runs, trace read, or a separate approval-read), and are they part of run views by default?
options: Approvals are included in run inspection output.
Approvals are available only via trace reading.
open_points.default_guess: Approvals are included in run inspection output, with personal-data masking for agents.
